description: Publishes a Sitecore item. On SitecoreAI there is no web database — content publishes to Edge, which lives on Sitecore's cloud servers only, so this works on deployed environments but a local development CM has no publishing target.

asJob.description: The Sitecore API called to perform the publish is different with this parameter.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

fromDate.description: Publishes items newer than the date provided only. An ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. '2026-01-31' or '2026-01-31T09:00:00Z'.

id.description: The ID of the item that should be published. Supply this or path.

language.description: The language of the item that should be published. Supports globbing/wildcards.

path.description: The path of the item that should be published. Supply this or id.

recurse.description: Publishes the subitems with the root item.

republishAll.description: Republishes all items provided to the publishing job.

target.description: Specifies the publishing target. The default target database is 'web'.

name: common-publish-item
